comment: kiln.world, game-program wraps (0.2.0-dev.28, chapter 06a): the program scheduler's live path and the players mask that decides whether a world's program slices run inline on the world's thread or as tasks on the game's workers. Wraps themselves need no symbol of their own (they swap the update pointer of a program-table entry, entry+0x28, with the world/programs.* constants); these resolve the scheduler for the threads report and the lab's parallel switch. SimStep (it sets storage+0x518 = 1 at entry, so it always takes this path) calls RunInitPrograms, then StepPrograms in a loop: StepPrograms' prologue decides parallel per world kind (server: the u16 players mask at storage+mask != 0; prediction: never; client: always), cuts slices and runs ProgramRunner (types/ProgramRunner) inline or posts SliceTaskFn tasks. The players mask holds bit (id-1) mod 16 for every live player entity (ids 1..1023). Same bytes on server 26430253 (f0d824be) and client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1); svn 1273043 (d7baa768) has another prologue frame size, which the second StepPrograms strategy (the kind dispatch, 0x22 bytes in) does not depend on.
